title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Tract No. 83478, located at 5601 West Santa Monica Boulevard, easterly of Wilton Place.
text:
[Council File 23-1329-S2; CD 13]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Tract No. 83478, located at 5601 West Santa Monica Boulevard, easterly of Wilton Place.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Tract No. 83478, located at 5601 West Santa Monica Boulevard, easterly of Wilton Place and accompanying Subdivision Improvement Agreement and Contract with security documents.
C-147063
Owner: Santa Monica Boulevard LLC ; Surveyor: Christopher M. Jones
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $14,740 for the processing of this final tract map pursuant to Section 19.02(A)(2) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted.
